root_cause: The current sentence builder validates source licensing, script plausibility, target uniqueness, and length, then ranks primarily from English-side usefulness. It does not validate French grammar, register, or bilingual semantic equivalence before selecting the top 1000.
release_requirements: Compile an explicit row decision for every rank 1-1000 from the completed row-by-row audit.
Use those row decisions as the sole correction/replacement input rather than re-deriving edits independently.
Second-pass verify every CORRECT, REPLACE, and NATIVE_REVIEW row before approval.
Regenerate French sentence CSV and sentence-bearing PDFs from approved row decisions only.
Run deterministic structural/render regression QA and independent native/editorial review before an absolute correctness claim.
